name: Hemington Road and the brook

layers.essential_history: [[c:A brook runs along the south of the village, between the houses and the fields.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The old village has grown little over the centuries: about 480 people lived in the parish in 2011.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Arthur the landlord says he locked up at eleven and was in bed by half past. But his dog was barking at a guest's window at one.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Arthur's guest]]
material: [[c:ARTHUR: "Only one guest stayed at the inn that night."]]
[[c:ARTHUR: "Peggy lives at the farm hostel. Hank sleeps at the base."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who was the guest at the inn? (surname)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:The only guest was Mr Pryce, the salesman. The dog barked at his window at one in the morning.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Mr Pryce was the only guest at the inn, and was out of his room at one.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north, about 440 metres as the crow flies, to the Kings Arms.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
